features: Dual Socket E (LGA-4677) 4th Gen Intel® Xeon® Scalable processors
Configurable PCIe slot options up to 8 PCIe 5.0 x8 (6 FHFL+ 2 FHHL) or 4 PCIe 5.0 x16 (3 FHFL + 1 FHHL)
Flexible networking options with 2 AIOM networking slots (OCP NIC 3.0 compatible)
Up to 6x 2.5" hot-swap drive bays with options to support NVMe/SATA drives
6 heavy duty hot-swap fans with optimal fan speed control

CPU: Future support for the upcoming 5th Gen Intel® Xeon® processors
Note: Supports up to 350W TDP CPUs (Air Cooled)

NVMe: NVMe; RAID 0/1/5/10 support (Intel® VROC RAID Key required)
IPMI: Support for Intelligent Platform Management Interface v.2.0
IPMI 2.0 with virtual media over LAN and KVM-over-LAN support

Power Configurations: Power-on mode for AC power recovery

Hardware: Silicon Root of Trust (RoT) – NIST 800-193 Compliant

Note: Standard sliding rail kit: Post to Post 19.1" ~ 26.4"

PCI-Express (PCI-E): Slot 1: PCIe 5.0 x16 FHFL;Slot 2: PCIe 5.0 x16 FHFL;Slot 3: PCIe 5.0 x16 FHFL;Slot 4: PCIe 5.0 x16 FHFL;Slot 5: PCIe 5.0 x16 FHFL;Slot 6: PCIe 5.0 x16 FHFL;Slot 7: PCIe 5.0 x16 FHHL;Slot 8: PCIe 5.0 x16 FHHL
Note: If Slot 1 is configured as PCIe x16, Slot 2 will be disabled; If Slot 3 is configured as PCIe x16, Slot 4 will be disabled; If Slot 5 is configured as PCIe x16, Slot 6 will be disabled; (Optional) If Slot 7 is configured as PCIe x16, Slot 8 will be disabled.

Hot-swap: 6x 2.5" hot-swap NVMe/SATA/SAS drive bays (6x 2.5" NVMe hybrid) <!-- Print
